title: endpoint-throttle-dependency-mini-tracker
content:
Purpose:
A quick, pragmatic tracker to capture endpoints we may throttle temporarily during the Jun–Jul capacity squeeze and the knock-on dependency list. This is a lightweight sheet for cross-team prioritization and fast decisions (not final legal/contract doc).

Background/context:
- Traffic spike and cloud quota events predicted for next 3 weeks; we need quick mitigation list for endpoints with controllable user impact.
- Goal: identify ~10 candidates, estimate QPS reduction impact, cost delta, and the minimal action (config change, feature flag, rate limit).
- Use this as input to the capacity-runbook and for SRE + Product to approve temporary throttles.

Mini-tracker (rows = quick estimates & owners):
Columns: ID | Area | Endpoint / Job | Owner | Priority | Est QPS saved | Est extra cost/day ($) | Estimated p99 change | Action | ETA | Status | Notes

1 | hosted-api | /v1/embeddings/batch | Priya Nair | High | 220 qps | -60 | +8ms | apply 20% rate-limit on non-signed keys via API gateway | 2027-06-18 | in_review | affects some internal analytics; CC product analytics
2 | serving-runtime | realtime-llm/stream | Tomás Ruiz | High | 150 qps | -45 | +12ms | enable fallback to smol-llm-1 for low-priority traffic via routing policy | 2027-06-19 | in_progress | requires quick model-variant mapping (ENG-4521)
3 | private-deploy | sync-backup-job | Janelle Kim | Medium | 35 qps (batch) | -3 | 0ms | postpone nightly snapshot window by 4hrs | 2027-06-20 | planned | customer backups affected; notify ops
4 | devtools | metrics-export | Lina Park | Low | 40 qps | -2 | +2ms | disable realtime streaming for non-admins for 48h | 2027-06-17 | done | temporary UI degradation for dashboards
5 | dedicated | longpoll-poller | Aaron Holt | High | 180 qps | -50 | +30ms | throttle poller to 1/3 rate, add jitter | 2027-06-18 | in_progress | linked to INFRA-312 for autoscaler tweak
6 | platform | kv-prefix-cache-refresh | Priya Nair | Medium | 60 qps | -10 | +5ms | increase cache TTL for 72h | 2027-06-18 | in_review | watch cache hit-rate
7 | optimize | batch-rerank-job | Becky Shaw | Low | 25 qps | -1 | 0ms | shift to off-peak slots (2am) | 2027-06-21 | planned | non-customer-facing rerank
8 | console | events-stream | Tomás Ruiz | Medium | 95 qps | -18 | +6ms | switch console UI to sampling mode (10%) | 2027-06-19 | in_progress | product ok with degraded live events
9 | security | audit-ingest | Omar Khan | High | 120 qps | -20 | +2ms | bump instance pool for audit ingest or temporary queueing | 2027-06-20 | blocked | need security signoff for queueing behavior
10 | se-ps | demo-worker | Janelle Kim | Low | 15 qps | -0.5 | +1ms | put demo env behind separate token with limits | 2027-06-17 | done | helps free burst capacity for hosted

Quick color legend: High = customer-visible or cost-heavy; Medium = internal tooling or mixed; Low = low risk.

Top-level quick numbers (aggregates - rough):
- Total QPS reducible (sum of candidates): ~940 qps
- Estimated daily cost delta if throttled aggressively (ballpark): ~$210/day saved
- Expected latency tail impact (p99 aggregate if all changes live): +6ms average, some endpoints +30ms

Immediate asks (who to ping):
- SRE: confirm autoscaler impact on dedicated pools (Tomás)
- Product owners: approve console sampling and embeddings rate-limit (Priya, product-hosted-api)
- Security: approve audit ingest queueing behavior (Omar)

Next steps / runbook snippets:
- Today: triage list, tag JIRAs for any infra changes (ENG-4521, INFRA-312), assign owners for rollout toggles.
- 24h: implement reversible feature-flagged changes for top 3 high-impact endpoints; monitor latency/cost.
- 72h: review customer impact; escalate any customer-visible regressions to CS slack #cs-ops.

Open questions / risks:
- Which customers are on private deployments that will be affected by TTL changes? (need SE list)
- Are any throttles contractually sensitive (SLA language)? Product to confirm.
- Does routing to smol-llm-1 materially change model outputs that violate quality contracts? Research to sign off.

Notes and links (quick refs):
- Detailed capacity runbook (Confluence): confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Capacity-runbook (linked in JIRA).
- Quick incident channel: #ops-throttle-2027 (Slack).
- PR for routing policy proof-of-concept: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/809
